entry_points.summary: Shared renderer: file/stdin JSON {corrections:[{title,why,target}], approach_concerns:[{concern,affected?,suggestion?}]} -> two-section markdown brief
Core rendering function: section 1 (Patched automatically N corrections) always present; section 2 (Worth your eyes M) only when approach_concerns non-empty
Gate-decision helper: maps (result, source) resolver envelope for workflow.audit_to_amend -> auto_split|force_ask|halt; exit 0=token printed, exit 1=bad input
5-rule precedence: halt wins; skip->auto_split; source==none->auto_split; explicit-source+ask|prefill->force_ask; all other->auto_split
Calls amend-gate-decision.py with resolver envelope; dispatches auto_split / force_ask / halt branches
Builds corrections + approach_concerns JSON and pipes to amendment-brief.py; presents output conversationally (no popup)
Calls amendment-brief.py with spec_gap corrections (from Phase 6.5) + premise_failure escalations; writes amendment-brief.md to archive; Finalize APPROACH_FILE prefers it

invariants: both /z-audit-plan and /z-review-all call the same scripts/amendment-brief.py — no duplicated format logic
auto_split never presents an AskUserQuestion popup; the brief is a conversational reply only
amend-gate-decision.py exits 1 on malformed input; orchestrator falls through to ask
amendment-brief.py always emits Patched-automatically line even when corrections=[]; omits Worth-your-eyes only when approach_concerns=[]
affected on approach_concerns is optional — premise_failure may be plan-level with no single task target
correction/approach are human glosses only — the canonical enum values are spec_gap and premise_failure (z-review-all.md:716)
amend-gate-decision.py source==none maps to auto_split (fresh user default); source in {config,memory} + result in {ask,prefill} maps to force_ask
halt gate token causes immediate abort; force_ask invokes the 3-way popup unchanged
workflow.audit_to_amend is in OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT as amend; maps to auto_split via rule 2 (result==skip)
gotchas: amendment-brief.py absent approach_concerns yields no Worth-your-eyes section at all — do not test for a blank section, test for its absence
amend-gate-decision.py prints the token with no trailing newline; shell $(…) captures will strip it anyway but be aware
source==none is the common case for a fresh install — always routes to auto_split regardless of result value
amend-gate-decision.py is called only by /z-audit-plan Phase 5; /z-review-all does not call it (Phase 6.5 auto-amend is unconditional)
if amend-gate-decision.py exits 1 (bad input), the orchestrator should fall through to the force_ask / ask branch, not halt
amendment-brief.py correction target field is a file path string (e.g. SPEC.md); do not confuse with the full artifact path
